item.title: Kentucky launches new mobile ID app, Apple Wallet support coming soon
item.description: Kentucky today launched its new Kentucky mobile ID app for iPhone, allowing residents to access a digital version of their ID. While the app itself is available on the App Store starting today, there’s a big upgrade coming this summer: support for storing your Kentucky ID in Apple Wallet. more…

item.title: New MacBook accessory adds touch support to your display
item.description: The first touch-enabled Mac is rumored to launch later this year, but a new third-party ‘Magic Screen’ accessory says it can bring touch to existing MacBook Air and MacBook Pro displays. more…

item.title: Dell announces massive 52-inch 6K display with Thunderbolt
item.description: As part of CES 2026 this week, Dell today unveiled what it says is the “world’s first 52-inch 6K monitor.” The new Dell UltraSharp 52 Thunderbolt Hub Monitor features a 52-inch ultra wide curved display. That equates to 129 pixel-per-inch density. more…

item.title: Apple releases iOS 26.3 security test for beta users, details here
item.description: If you’re running the iOS 26.3 beta, Apple has just released a new security update you can install. But there’s a catch: rather than including fixes, the update is simply testing out a new system. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Apple TV has long-delayed thriller series returning this week
item.description: Tehran is one of Apple TV’s longest running thriller series, but you may have never heard of it because for years, the new season’s release has been delayed. Recently though, Apple announced that Tehran season 3 is finally about to premiere, and there’s even a season 4 on the way. more…
